description: Download or back up a remote artifact's original files, including binary assets. Without path, returns a manifest, versionId and authenticated ZIP download URL. To retrieve everything using MCP alone, call again for each manifest path with version_id and offset; decode base64 and repeat nextOffset until done. No CLI is required. Use version_id to read an authorized historical snapshot; pin all chunks to the manifest version. Read the latest version separately before editing. Requires original-content access, which may be stricter than text read access. Never put the Bearer token in a URL.

length.description: Bytes per download chunk, at most 262144.

offset.description: Byte offset for file download, initially 0.

path.description: Relative file path from the export manifest; omit to get the manifest.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

version_id.description: Required with path; pins an authorized immutable snapshot, also accepted without path.

name: artifact_site_export
title: Export a site
